title: Two connected people on two different apps exchange a message each way
summary: After a shared ceremony, each side sends the other one message as a Trust Task document in a TSP envelope through one mediator. The receiving app shows it in the right conversation and can answer.
waitingOn: agreement on a shared message document type (proposal) and a counterpart on the same mediator

vectors.label: RLTP message@1 (pairwise MAC, no transferable proof)
